io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks

Class MultiBlockAssembler

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks.MultiBlockAssembler

  • public final class MultiBlockAssembler
extends java.lang.Object
    Builds a multiblock's whole structure in the world when a player "places" the machine item, rather than the item being an unplaceable no-op. This works for every core and addon multiblock because the layout is read straight from its MultiBlock, and (via assembleAround(org.bukkit.Material[], java.lang.String[], org.bukkit.block.Block, org.bukkit.entity.Player)) for any other addon item that anchors its own structure the same way, without having to become a MultiBlockMachine itself.

    The structure is anchored on the clicked surface - its bottom row sits where a normal block would go and it rises upward - and oriented to the player's facing. It only builds if every required cell is free (or already the matching hand-placed block) and the player may build there; otherwise nothing is placed or consumed. Cells are placed bottom-up over a few ticks as a simple assembly animation. A cell may require a specific custom (Slimefun) block rather than just a Material; that block is placed and registered in BlockStorage exactly as a normal placement would, including calling its BlockPlaceHandler. If a required custom block's id cannot be resolved, or its item declines automated placement, nothing is built and nothing is consumed.

      • assembleAround

        public static boolean assembleAround(@Nonnull
                                     org.bukkit.Material[] layout,
                                     @Nullable
                                     java.lang.String[] customBlocks,
                                     @Nonnull
                                     org.bukkit.block.Block center,
                                     @Nonnull
                                     org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Builds a 9-cell structure (see MultiBlock.getStructure() for the cell layout) with its centre at center, for a SlimefunItem that anchors its own multiblock structure directly - rather than being a MultiBlockMachine whose item is an unplaceable token - such as a placeable controller block that should auto-build the machinery around it. The anchor block is expected to already occupy the centre cell (index 4), whose layout entry should be null so it is left alone.

        Unlike assemble(io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks.MultiBlockMachine, org.bukkit.block.Block, org.bukkit.entity.Player, org.bukkit.inventory.EquipmentSlot), nothing is consumed and no dispenser ownership is claimed - both are specific to the core multiblock-machine/auto-craft feature, and are the caller's concern if relevant.

        Parameters:
        layout - The 9 required materials, null for a cell to leave alone
        customBlocks - Per-cell Slimefun item id (or null), see MultiBlock.getCustomBlocks(); may itself be null for an all-Material structure
        center - The block the structure's centre cell (index 4) occupies
        p - The player building it
        Returns:
        Whether the structure was built (false = blocked or no permission; nothing placed)
